title: Bug: test_everflow_per_interface.py has CLI command syntax error when run with erspan_ipv6
author: wrideout-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Currently, IPv6 erspan mirroring commands are not supported as configured from the CLI.  PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/22663 removed ASIC-command fallback for the IPv6 case.

https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/23603 also exists for this, but suggests actually fixing the CLI. 

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test `everflow/test_everflow_per_interface.py::test_everflow_packet_format[erspan_ipv6-ipv4-default]`.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test should not fail due to CLI command syntax issues.

comments.author: yxieca
comments.body:
AI review — no blocking issues (updated)

On re-review against the current head (`5f3e82cc`), the earlier queue-0 concern is resolved: `_build_v6_erspan_asic_command` already gates the queue field with `if queue_num is not None:` and single-quotes the value, so a legal queue 0 is handled correctly. This is a correctly-scoped regression fix that restores the IPv6 ERSPAN mirror-session setup path (the CLI does not support adding IPv6 ERSPAN sessions); the IPv4 CLI path is unchanged. No blocking issues.

AI-assisted review, reviewed and approved by Ying Xie (@yxieca).
